purpose: Test the already fitted R4 score correction with a new measurement-noise draw, and explicitly test float16 observation storage used by the official test file.
frozen_methods: R4 continuous-profile hybrid and spatial variant
normal: All 3232 reused normal audit realizations; paired float32 and float16-roundtrip observations.
noise: Per-map NumPy default_rng(991000 + flat training-map ID), sigma=0.4/sqrt(240), added before float16 roundtrip. Noise is paired across synthetic variants.
probe_maps: The same four audit positions 4, 9, 18 and 27 within each of the 101 cosmologies: 404 maps per family.
iaaft: Existing 60-iteration transform with per-map seed 861004+ID. Histogram matching is exact, power-spectrum matching is approximate; report mismatch.
fit_or_selection: No fitting of network weights, score regressors, ensemble weights or thresholds on these new observations. Existing normal calibration score arrays define thresholds and reference ROC curves.
field: Recompute both frozen field-model likelihoods with 32 Heun steps and trace probe seed 451 on each new observation.
limitations: Clean realizations, proxy families and audit set are reused; only measurement noise, IAAFT initialization and storage-roundtrip checks are new.
These synthetic scores do not estimate the hidden leaderboard score.
No public test inputs or scores are read.
scope: Four hosts of authorized erdos-3242 only. CPU preparation and TPU scoring use RAM-backed folders; no GCS or production changes.
